'''R-NT1''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed at the [[Imperial Lodgement]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
